title: NASA-UAP-D020, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part II, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 5 flight crew technical debriefing conducted by NASA in 1965. / This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 5 flight crew technical debriefing conducted by NASA in 1965, containing observations of various phenomena by astronauts L. Gordon Cooper and Charles Conrad.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed debris, 'snow', and glittering pieces floating outside the spacecraft during orbital flight.
incidents.quote: all sorts of glittering pieces of this, that and the other thing

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a washer floating outside the spacecraft window during orbital flight.
incidents.quote: here's that washer floating right in front of my window

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a bolt floating outside the spacecraft window during orbital flight.
incidents.quote: And about an hour later a bolt came off.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed an unidentified object while in drifting flight that they could not identify.
incidents.quote: There was only one time when Pete and I thought we saw something and we didn't have time to identify it.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a bright green Aurora-like light in the airglow layer that changed color and affected the airglow's appearance.
incidents.quote: It looked like an Aurora. It was an Aurora type light and it was a very bright green.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a large object reentering behind the spacecraft during the reentry phase.
incidents.quote: There was some object way behind.
